changes.summary: Accept absent or null budget_tokens for enabled thinking in the Anthropic route: the request uses the existing reasoning-enabled conversion. Explicit budgets keep their validation, and disabled/adaptive field rules are unchanged.

changes.author: John Pezzulli
changes.summary: A reasoning.effort supplied on a /v1/responses request now outranks the launch default through the existing request-first template policy. Nested overrides, omitted or null effort, summary-only schema defaults and explicit thinking-off controls keep their behavior; direct renderer precedence is retained for callers that do not opt in.

Reject incomplete FILE-backed NIXL restores: empty objects are lookup misses and each physical object is validated against its host-buffer byte count before a read. Missing, short and metadata-query failures return the existing failed-read result; complete and padded objects stay valid. Adapts sgl-project/sglang#46131 with bounded query-error handling for Penny prefetch workers.

QSA keeps its retained prefix index keys in the narrow speculative windows produced by the operator-selected fixed-w4 width policy; the public default stays tiered. Two pending index-key ring groups for speculative widths 2 through the compression ratio, allocation still tied to the launch maximum, undersized or unresolved verify geometry refused by the existing guard, and the group-partitioned layout from #40143 preserved. Adapts sgl-project/sglang#46125.
profiles: Flash-Next QSA under the optional fixed-w4 width policy

changes.summary: Truncated hybrid-Mamba prefill chunks are floored to the KV page size before commit, so a cached hybrid state is never named by a key shorter than the prefix it summarizes; a chunk with under one page of budget is parked and retried on the existing deferral path. No-op unless the cache holds Mamba state on a paged pool; untruncated tails and full-attention profiles are untouched. Restates sgl-project/sglang#45607 against this fork's PrefillAdder.
profiles: Hybrid Mamba profiles under chunked prefill

changes.summary: An already-empty running batch no longer keeps the batch_is_full latch. The latch was cleared only when the batch shrank or when an empty prefill-only batch came round; a batch that was already empty matches neither test, because it has no request left to leave, and the rows that produced the latch can be released from outside it (closing an idle streaming session frees the held KV and the request-to-token row and touches no latch), so waiting requests starved with a free pool. Any empty batch now reopens admission; a batch that still holds requests resets only on a shrink, as before. This is the selected hunk of #126; the ownership and capacity changes are not included.

Maturity labeling corrected in current guidance: 27B + DFlash2 is established and qualified, and only the optional Flash-Next next-dflash2 profile keeps the experimental / alpha label. The commit at the head of the qualified candidate (ef3258749) is the change that added that label to both DFlash2 profiles; the correction merged as PR #133, head 278893c317e7f46a8f127024f3c3ae3f4412febd, merge commit f38baf2f84337a7f86ee5d2b38ff95c868f05ae8. The draft's additional host cache stays documented on both DFlash2 profiles, separate from maturity: no allocator change and no memory reduction is claimed. Labels and documentation only - no setting, default, launch line, runtime module or test changed.

defaults_unchanged.native_mtp_width_policy: tiered (block 8 at one running request, block 4 at two or more)
defaults_unchanged.operator_local_selection: adaptive width policy, medium reasoning effort, diagnostics off
defaults_unchanged.note: No settings or default changes in this release; the width-policy rows in RESULTS.md were measured with adaptive selected.

validation.focused_cpu_checks: Accepted Oct27 run on the candidate, CPU only: integrated suite passed 409 tests with 404 subtests and 1 optional S3 skip; not rerun for documentation work. Checked again in the source venv for the corrected records on 2026-10-27: 102 focused CPU tests with 42 subtests passed (36 config/setup/recipe checks plus 66 registered container-launch, startup-version and release-routing checks). Pinned Black 26.1.0 and codespell 2.4.1 report no changes on the edited files. Runtime qualification was not rerun.
validation.review: Each of the six fixes was reviewed individually and accepted; exact patch-id equality with the accepted contributions was verified.
validation.regression: The focused regressions for #109, #122, #123, #124 and the Responses effort fix are red on the 742cbc5 base and green with the fix.
validation.cuda_regression: QSA coverage for the narrow-window case ran on the production shape under the optional fixed-w4 policy, with retained-prefix residues of 1, 2 and 3 tokens, partial acceptance and fused compression; serving checks passed 9/9.
validation.api_probes: The two profiles this candidate carries day to day - Flash-Next native MTP and 27B DFlash2 - each passed 4/4 API probes, a sealed agentic run of 6 turns with 5 tool calls, vision checks, and correct 63,906-token and 489,921-token retrieval. The optional Flash-Next DFlash2 profile was not requalified on this candidate.
validation.cache_restore: Fresh-process 64K and 490K NIXL restores were correct on Flash-Next native MTP and on 27B DFlash2: 553,792 NIXL-backed KV tokens plus 4 Mamba states each, and additionally 4,096 sliding-window tokens on 27B. Both restart restores are valid. Duplicate replays answered from the device cache rather than four independent disk loads. These are end-to-end restore results, not a dedicated checkpoint-grid scatter regression.
validation.reasoning: All 36 measured requests completed naturally with no confirmed loops; extended reasoning is not penalized. Blind scores: Flash-Next native MTP 95.36 (sequential) and 97.61 (three concurrent users); 27B DFlash2 98.67 and 99.23.
validation.tools: Counts with exceptions, not a blanket pass. Flash-Next native MTP: 30/30 calls parseable, 29/30 strict-matcher, 26/30 automatic; the four automatic misses come from scorer/date substring behaviour and mock-router behaviour rather than model call failures. 27B DFlash2: 30/30 scheduled, exact and parseable, 28/30 automatic; the two misses are the invalid-date test cases, where the model issued the correct validate_date calls and then used its whole 512-token output ceiling on reasoning, returning a final answer with an empty visible body. One invoice request also returned unwanted explanatory prose alongside a correct call. Agentic and vision checks passed separately.
validation.benchmarks: Dated native mean/peak rates and cold TTFT for this candidate are recorded in RESULTS.md with the measured policy, configuration, source and interval counts. No matched-baseline speed-up claim is made and no new performance default changed.
validation.container_build: Published: build 40525831339 (started 2026-10-27T14:55:27Z, source ec1f64e85) produced the checked candidate image, promoted without rebuilding to ghcr.io/jpezzulli/sglang-rtxpro6000:v3.1.3 by run 40549616706, digest sha256:cdba5f8d72098813454aa552bad35873d65b2ba8cd72f93f3ae3ed7057c0636a. Existing-image verification on 2026-10-27 with GPUs hidden and network none passed: pinned packages, the accepted FlashInfer SM120 sources and AOT module, NIXL POSIX/FILE and DRAM transport configuration, the NVMe PLE io_uring import and clean exact source; the 28 runtime, launch, policy and version files hash-matched; the 8 installed NVMe-reader Python files matched the vendored source; the obsolete NVMe source manifest was absent; and the 16 existing recipe tests passed inside the image. An actual-GPU container serving smoke then PASSED on the Flash-Next profile with the public tiered width policy at TP1, 4 requests / 24 slots, 524,288-token context, 32 GB HiCache with NIXL, RAM PLE and CPU preprocessing and local diagnostics off: model discovery and health passed, request 1 returned the exact READY answer with a stop finish, request 2 returned the exact lookup_alpha (key ALPHA) and lookup_bravo (key BRAVO) calls as valid JSON with a tool_calls finish and no prose, and both requests completed. Native was then restored byte-for-byte and passed the same two checks at adaptive, 6 requests / 36 slots, A4000 GPU preprocessing and diagnostics off. This is image-serving evidence only: not a new throughput qualification, not a 27B container boot and no NVMe PLE serving qualification. The bounded 20-second stop used SIGKILL, so graceful container stop is not claimed.
exceptions: The first attempt at the 27B four-request screen on 2026-10-27 ended with an Xid 109 GPU freeze; the unchanged retry completed and is the recorded measurement. Cause unproven, no freeze fix claimed, event still under observation.

Under host-cache pressure, state was evicted rather than retained purely on the host. Host checkpoint reclamation and the NIXL disk-budget cleaner were both active during that run, so pure-host retention was not isolated on this candidate.

The #115 decode-checkpoint arithmetic remains covered by its 3.1.2 CPU regression. The Oct27 restore results are end-to-end, not a grid-scatter unit regression, and no isolated GPU check of that path exists on either DFlash2 profile. The optional Flash-Next DFlash2 profile was not requalified on this candidate.
